scope: Theorem 3.13 (Special termination for a chosen dlt scaling) of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Gd for every d < n. Let (X, B) be an effective rational dlt pair on a smooth compact Kähler n-fold, and suppose L = KX +B is pseudo-effective. There is a Kähler scaling direction ω, with {L} + ω Kähler, and a scaling as in Lemma 3.6, such that after finitely many steps the exceptional, flipping, and flipped loci are disjoint from the reduced floors of the working pairs.
